title: Nucleic acid amplification-free, aptamer-gated Cas13a-Csm6 cascade for signal-on electrochemical detection of carcinoembryonic antigen in esophageal cancer.
snippet: Carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) is a clinically relevant tumor-associated biomarker that has been investigated for auxiliary assessment and monitoring in the context of esophageal cancer. title: Drugging the luminal axis end to end: A review of next-generation endocrine and targeted therapies in HR + /HER2- metastatic breast cancer.
snippet: Hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative (HR+/HER2-) breast cancer is driven by an interconnected signaling network centered on estrogen receptor (ER)-dependent transcription.
